90.ja: סימן. [א]. קאל אלחבר צפהֵ אלמתעבד ענדנא ליס במנקטע ען אלדניא כי לא יציר כלא עליהא ותציר כלא עליה פיבג'ץ' [חיאתה] אלתי הי מן נעם אללה עליה וימתן בהא עליה כקולה את מספר ימיך אמלא, והארכת ימים.
90.en: Section One. The rabbi said: The devout man among us is not one who withdraws from the world, for then the world would be empty of him and he of it, and he would come to loathe [his life], which is among God's blessings upon him — and God holds it over him as a gift — as it is said: I will fill the number of your days, and you shall have length of days.

pairs.en: the devout man
is not one who withdraws from the world

pairs.ja: כי לא יציר כלא עליהא ותציר כלא עליה
pairs.en: lest the world be empty of him and he of it

pairs.ja: אלתי הי מן נעם אללה עליה
pairs.en: which is among God's blessings upon him
I will fill the number of your days

90.ja: בל יחב אלדניא וטול אלעמר לאנהא תכסבה אלאכ'רה וכל מא זאד חסנה רקי דרג'ה פי אלאכ'רה.
90.en: Rather, he loves the world and long life, because the world earns him the world to come, and every increase of his piety raises him a degree in the world to come.

pairs.en: he loves the world and long life
because it earns him the world to come
every increase of his piety
raises him a degree in the world to come

90.ja: נעם אנה [יוד לו] יציר פי רתבהֵ חנוך אלד'י קיל פיה ויתהלך חנוך או רתבהֵ אליהו ליתפרג' חתי יתפרד לצחבהֵ אלמלאיכה פלא יתסוחש פי אלוחדה ואלכ'לוה בל הי אנסה. ויסתוחש פי אלמלא לפקדה משאהדהֵ מלכות אלסמא אלתי תגניה ען אלאכל ואלשרב.
90.en: Indeed, were he to attain the rank of Enoch, of whom it is said 'and Enoch walked with God,' or the rank of Elijah — allowing him to withdraw into the companionship of the angels — then he would feel no loneliness in solitude and seclusion, for that would be his intimacy. And he would feel estranged in a crowd, missing the contemplation of the kingdom of heaven which sustains him beyond eating and drinking.

pairs.en: the rank of Enoch
and Enoch walked with God
into the companionship of the angels
the kingdom of heaven
which sustains him beyond eating and drinking

90.ja: פלמת'ל האולא יחק באלתפרד אלתאם בל יתמנון אלמות אד' קד בלגוא אלנהאיה אלתי ליס בעדהא דרג'ה תרג'י זיאדתהא.
90.en: For such as these, complete withdrawal is fitting — indeed, they long for death, since they have reached the ultimate station beyond which there is no higher degree to be hoped for.

pairs.en: such as these
complete withdrawal is fitting
they long for death
they have reached the ultimate station
beyond which there is no higher degree

90.ja: וללעלמא אלמתפלספה [חב] פי אלתפרד לתצפו אפכארהם לינתג'וא מן קיאסאתהם נתאיג' חק חתי יחצל להם אליקין פי מא תבקי עליהם מן אלשכוך. וירידון מע הד'א לקא תלאמיד' ידעונהם [אלי] אלבחת' ואלתד'כר כמן ולע בג'מע אלמאל פהו יכרה אלאשתגאל אלא מע מן יתאג'רה פירבח מעה.
90.en: As for the philosophically-minded scholars, they love withdrawal so that their thoughts may be clarified and they may draw true conclusions from their syllogisms, until they attain certainty regarding whatever doubts remain for them. Together with this, they also desire to meet students, summoning them to inquiry and contemplation — like one consumed with amassing wealth who dislikes any occupation except trading with those who bring him profit.

pairs.en: the philosophically-minded scholars
so that their thoughts may be clarified
they may draw true conclusions
to meet students
summoning them to inquiry and contemplation

90.ja: והד'ה דרג'הֵ סקראט ומן אשבהה. והאולא אפראד לא מטמע פי דרג'תהם אליום.
90.en: This is the rank of Socrates and those like him. Such individuals are rare, and today there is no hope of attaining their station.

pairs.en: the rank of Socrates
such individuals are rare
today there is no hope of attaining their station

90.ja: נעם אן בחצ'רה אלשכינה פי אלארץ' אלמקדסה פי אלאמה אלמהיאה ללנבוה כאן כ'לק יתזהדון ויסכנון אלקפאר מג'תמעין מע מן שאכלהם לא מתפרדין באלג'מלה בל יתעאונון עלי עלום
90.en: Indeed, in the time of the Divine Presence in the Holy Land, within the people prepared for prophecy, there were those who practiced asceticism and dwelt in the wilderness, gathered together with like-minded companions — not entirely alone, but cooperating with one another in the study of the sciences

pairs.en: the presence of the Shekhinah in the Holy Land
the people prepared for prophecy
practiced asceticism and dwelt in the wilderness
gathered with like-minded companions
cooperating with one another in the study of the sciences

91.ja: אלשריעה ואעמאלהא אלמקרבה אלי תלך אלדרג'ה בקדושה ובטהרה והם בני הנביאים.
91.en: of the Torah and its practices that draw one near to that degree — through holiness and purity — and these were the disciples of the prophets.

pairs.en: the Torah and its practices
that draw one near to that degree
through holiness and purity
disciples of the prophets

91.ja: ואמא פי הד'א אלזמאן והד'א אלמכאן והד'א אלכ'לק ואין חזון נפרץ מע קלהֵ אלעלם אלמכתסב ועדם ד'לך אלעל<ם> אלמטבוע. מן חצל נפסה פי אלאנקטאע באלזהאדה פקד חצל נפסה פי עד'אב ומרץ' נפסי וג'סמי.
91.en: But in this age, this place, and this generation — where 'prophecy is not widespread' (ואין חזון נפרץ), and where acquired knowledge is scant and that innate knowledge is absent — whoever places his soul in the path of withdrawal through asceticism has placed his soul into spiritual and bodily torment and sickness.

pairs.en: this age and this place
prophecy is not widespread
acquired knowledge is scant
withdrawal through asceticism
spiritual and bodily torment and sickness

91.ja: פירי עליה תד'לל אלאמראץ' פיט'ן אנה תד'לל באלכ'שוע ואלכ'צ'וע ויחצל מסג'ונא יכפר באלחיאה מלאלא לסג'נה ואלאמה לא אלתד'אד'א באלתפרד.
91.en: He sees upon himself the degradation of ailments and imagines that this is a prostration of humility and submission — and he ends up imprisoned, weary of life on account of his imprisonment, and weary of people, not because he has found intimacy in solitude.

pairs.en: the degradation of ailments
imagines that this is a prostration of humility and submission
imprisoned, weary of life
on account of his imprisonment and people
not because he found intimacy in solitude

91.ja: וכיף לא והו לם יתצל בנור אלאהי יאנס אליה כאלאנביא ולא חצל עלומא מא תפי באשגאלה ותלד'יד'ה בקיהֵ עמרה כאלפלאספה.
91.en: And how could it be otherwise? He has not been joined to a divine light in which he might find intimacy, as the prophets were, nor has he attained sciences sufficient to occupy and delight him for the rest of his life, as the philosophers do.

pairs.en: he has not been joined to a divine light
find intimacy therein, as the prophets did
sciences sufficient to occupy and delight him
for the rest of his life, as the philosophers do

91.ja: והב אנה ורע כ'יר מחב פי מנאג'אהֵ רבה פי אלכ'לוה ואלקיאם ואלתצ'רע ואלתחנן מא עסאה אן יחפט' מן אלתחנונים ואלבקשות. והד'ה אלמבתדעאת אנמא להא לד'ה איאם מהמא תטרא وكل מא תכררת עלי אללסאן לם תנפעל להא אלנפס ולא וג'ד להא שג'א ותחנינא.
91.en: Suppose he is pious and good, devoted to communing with his Lord in seclusion, standing, prostrating, and supplicating — how much can he retain of supplications and petitions? These invented devotions only bring pleasure for a few days when they first appear; the more they are repeated on the tongue, the less the soul responds to them, feeling no yearning or supplication.

pairs.en: communing with his Lord in seclusion
prostrating and supplicating
these invented devotions
only bring pleasure for a few days when they appear
the soul does not respond to them

91.ja: פיבקי אלליל ואלנהאר ונפסה תטלבה בקואהא אלתי טבעת עליהא מן אלנט'ר ואלסמע ואלכלאם ואלתצרף ואלאכל ואלשרב ואלנכאח ואלרבח פי אלאמואל ואלאצלאח עלי אלאהל ומשארכה אלצ'עפא ומעאונהֵ אלשריעה באלמאל.
91.en: So he spends days and nights while his soul demands of him, with the natural drives it was endowed with, those things pertaining to seeing, hearing, speaking, activity, eating, drinking, marriage, profit in trade, providing for his household, supporting the poor, and aiding the Torah with his wealth.

pairs.en: his soul demands of him with its natural drives
seeing, hearing, and speaking
eating, drinking, and marriage
supporting the poor
aiding the Torah with his wealth

91.ja: אד'א ראי אכ'תלאלא אליס יבקי מנתשבא נאדמא עלי מא רבט נפסה אליה פיזיד בנדאמתה בעדא מן אלאמר אלאלאהי אלד'י ראם קרבה.
91.en: When he sees disorder, does he not remain troubled, regretful of that to which he has bound his soul — so that his regret increases his distance from the divine command he sought to draw near?

pairs.en: when he sees disorder
troubled and regretful
that to which he has bound his soul
distance from the divine command
he sought to draw near

91.ja: סימן. [ב]. קאל אלכ'זרי פלתצף לי אעמאל כ'ירכם אלאן. סימן. [ג]. קאל אלחבר אן אלכ'יר הו אלמחאפט' עלי מדינתה יקסט ויקדר עלי אהלהא ארזאקהם וג'מיע חאג'תהם ויעדל פיהם בחית' לא יגבן אחדהם ולא יעטיה
91.en: Section Two. The Khazar said: Describe for me then the deeds of your pious men. Section Three. The rabbi said: The pious man is one who governs his city-state justly, apportioning to its inhabitants their sustenance and all their needs, dealing equitably among them such that he neither deprives any of them nor gives to one

pairs.en: Section Two. The Khazar said
describe for me the deeds of your pious men
Section Three. The rabbi said
the pious man is one who governs his city-state
he neither deprives any of them

92.ja: פוק חקה אלד'י יסתחקה ת'ם יג'דהם פי וקת חאג'תה אליהם מטיעין סריעי אלאג'אבה לדעותה יאמרהם פיאתמרון וינהיהם פינתהון.
92.en: more than his due. Then he finds them, in the hour of his need, obedient and swift to respond to his summons — he commands them and they comply, he forbids them and they desist.

pairs.en: more than his rightful due
in the hour of his need for them
obedient and swift to respond
he commands them and they comply
he forbids them and they desist

92.ja: סימן. [ד]. קאל אלכ'זרי ען כ'יר סאלתך לא ען רייס. סימן. [ה]. קאל אלחבר אלכ'יר הו מן כאן ריסא מטאעא עלי חואסה וקואה אלנפסאניה ואלבדניה ויסוסהא אלסיאסה אלמדניה כמא קיל ומושל ברוחו מלוכד עיר.
92.en: Section Four. The Khazar said: I asked you about a pious man, not a ruler. Section Five. The rabbi said: The pious man is one who is an obeyed master over his senses and his psychic and bodily faculties, governing them with civic discipline, as it is said: 'One who rules his spirit is better than one who conquers a city.'

pairs.en: Section Four. The Khazar said

pairs.ja: ען כ'יר סאלתך לא ען רייס
pairs.en: I asked you about a pious man, not a ruler

pairs.ja: אלכ'יר הו מן כאן ריסא מטאעא
pairs.en: the pious man is one who is an obeyed master
over his senses and his psychic and bodily faculties
one who rules his spirit is better than one who conquers a city

92.ja: והו אלמהיא ללריאסה לאנה לו ראס מדינה לעדל פיהא כמא עדל פי בדנה ונפסה פקמע אלקוי אלשהואניה ומנעהא ען אלאנהמאל בעד אנצאפהא ואעטאיהא מא יסד כ'ללהא באלטעאם אלקצד ואלשראב אלקצד ואלאסתחמאם ואסבאבה בקצד איצ'א.
92.en: He is fit for true leadership, for were he to rule a city he would deal justly in it as he deals justly with his body and soul. He subdues the appetitive faculties and prevents them from excess, after giving them their due share and providing what fills their needs — measured food, measured drink, and bathing and its accessories in moderation as well.

pairs.en: fit for true leadership
were he to rule a city he would deal justly in it
he subdues the appetitive faculties
after giving them their due share
measured food and measured drink

92.ja: וקמע איצ'א אלקוי אלג'צ'ביה אלטאלבה לט'הור אלגלבה בעד אנצאפהא ואעטאיהא חט'א פי אלג'לבה אלנאפעה מן מנאט'ראת אלעלום ואלארא וזג'ר אהל אלשר ואעטי אלחואס חט'הא פימא יעוד נפעה עליה.
92.en: He likewise subdues the irascible faculties that seek to manifest dominance, after giving them their share in the kind of dominance that is beneficial — namely, the disputation of intellectual matters and opinions, and the reproof of evil-doers. And he assigns the senses their portion in what will benefit him.

pairs.en: the irascible faculties
that seek to manifest dominance
the kind of dominance that is beneficial
the disputation of intellectual matters and opinions
the reproof of evil-doers

92.ja: פיצרף אלידין ואלקדמין ואללסאן פי אלאמר אלצ'רורי ופי אלאכ'תיאר אלאנפע. וכד'לך אלסמע ואלבצר ואלחס אלמשתרך תאבע להמא. ת'ם אלתכ'יל ואלוהם ואלפכר ואלד'כר ת'ם אלקוה אלאראדיה אלמצרפה לג'מיע הד'א והי מצרפה כ'אדמה לאכ'תיאר אלעקל.
92.en: He directs the hands, feet, and tongue toward what is necessary and toward the most beneficial choice. Similarly he directs hearing and sight — and the common sense that follows them. Then come imagination, fantasy, thought, and memory; and then the volitional faculty that governs all of these, itself serving the choices of the intellect.

pairs.en: the hands, feet, and tongue
what is necessary
imagination, fantasy, thought, and memory
the volitional faculty that governs all of these
serving the choices of the intellect

92.ja: ולא ידע אחדא מן הד'ה אלאעצ'א ואלקוי אן ינהמל פי מא יכ'צה וחדה פיבכ'ס אלבאקיה. ולמא קצ'י חאג'הֵ כל ואחדה מנהא ואעטי אלטביעיה
92.en: He allows none of these organs and faculties to fall into excess in what pertains to it alone, thereby diminishing the rest. And when he has satisfied the need of each one of them and given the natural faculties

pairs.ja: לא ידע אחדא מן הד'ה אלאעצ'א ואלקוי
pairs.en: he allows none of these organs and faculties

pairs.ja: אן ינהמל פי מא יכ'צה וחדה
pairs.en: to fall into excess in what pertains to it alone
thereby diminishing the rest
when he has satisfied the need of each one of them
and given the natural faculties

93.ja: מא יכפיהא מן אלסכון ואלנום ואלחיואניה מא יקותהא מן אליקט'הֵ ואלחרכה פי אעמאל אלדניא דעא חיניד' ג'מאעתה כאלריס אלמטאע ידעו עסכרה אלמטיע אלי מא יעינה עלי אלאתצאל באלרתבה אלתי פוקהא.
93.en: what suffices them of rest and sleep — and the animal faculties what nourishes them of waking and movement in worldly activities — then he summons his company, like the obeyed commander who summons his compliant army to what helps him attain connection with the rank above him.

pairs.en: what suffices them of rest and sleep
what nourishes them of waking and movement
he summons his company like the obeyed commander
his compliant army
attaining connection with the rank above him

93.ja: אעני אלרתבה אלאלאהיה אלתי פוק אלרתבה אלעקליה פירתב גמאעתה וינט'מהא יחאכי תרתיב משה רבינו ע'ה' ג'מאעתה חול הר סיני.
93.en: I mean the divine rank that is above the rational rank. So he arranges and orders his company, imitating the arrangement of our teacher Moses, peace be upon him, with his company around Mount Sinai.

pairs.en: the divine rank
that is above the rational rank
he arranges and orders his company
imitating the arrangement of our teacher Moses
his company around Mount Sinai

93.ja: ויוצי אלקוה אלאראדיה אן תכון קאבלה מטיעה למא ירד מן ענדה מן אמר פתמתת'לה מן חינהא פתצרף אלקוי ואלאעצ'א עלי מא יאמר דון כ'לאף.
93.en: He instructs the volitional faculty to be receptive and obedient to whatever command issues from him, so that it complies with it immediately and directs the faculties and organs according to what he commands, without opposition.

pairs.en: the volitional faculty

pairs.ja: קאבלה מטיעה למא ירד מן ענדה
pairs.en: receptive and obedient to whatever command issues from him
so that it complies with it immediately
directs the faculties and organs
without opposition

93.ja: ויוציהא אלא תלתפת אלי שיאטין אלוהמיה ואלמתכ'ילה ולא תקבלהמא ולא תצדקהמא חתי תשאור אלעקל פאן ג'וז מא ענדהמא קבלתה ואלא עצתהמא.
93.en: He instructs it not to heed the demons of fantasy and imagination, neither accepting nor affirming what they present, until it first consults the intellect; and if the intellect deems what they present permissible, it accepts it, otherwise it disobeys them.

pairs.en: the demons of fantasy and imagination
neither accepting nor affirming what they present
until it first consults the intellect
if the intellect deems what they present permissible it accepts it
otherwise it disobeys them

93.ja: פתקבל אלאראדיה ד'לך מנה ותצמם עלי אמתת'אלה פתסדד אלאת אלפכר ותכ'ליה מן כל מא תקדם מן אלאפכאר אלדניאיה ותכלף אלמתכ'ילה אחצ'אר אבהג' אלצור אלמוג'ודאת ענדהא.
93.en: The volitional faculty accepts this from the intellect and resolves to follow it; it then clears the instruments of thought and empties them of all preceding worldly thoughts, and commands the imagination to bring forward the most beautiful images it contains.

pairs.en: the volitional faculty resolves to follow it
it clears the instruments of thought
empties them of worldly thoughts
commands the imagination
the most beautiful images it contains

93.ja: במעונה אלד'כר לתחאכי בה אלאמר אלאלאהי אלמטלוב מת'ל מעמד הר סיני, ומעמד אברהם ויצחק בהר המוריה ומת'ל משכן משה ע'ה', וסדר עבודה וחלול אלכבוד פי אלבית.
93.en: With the aid of memory, so as to imitate thereby the divine reality sought — such as the standing at Mount Sinai, the standing of Abraham and Isaac at Mount Moriah, the Tabernacle of Moses peace be upon him, the order of worship, and the descent of the Glory upon the Temple.

pairs.en: with the aid of memory
to imitate the divine reality sought
the standing at Mount Sinai
the standing of Abraham and Isaac at Mount Moriah
the descent of the Glory upon the Temple

93.ja: וגיר ד'לך כת'יר ויאמר אלחאפט'ה אן תודע ד'לך ולא תנסאה ויזג'ר אלוהמיה ושיאטינהא מן תשויש אלחק ותשכיכה ויזג'ר אלגצ'ביה ואלשהואניה ען תמ[י]יל אלאראדיה ותחריפהא ואשגאלהא במא ענדהמא מן גצ'ב ושהוה.
93.en: And many other things like these. He commands the memory to record these and not forget them; he restrains fantasy and its demons from confusing and casting doubt on truth; and he restrains the irascible and appetitive faculties from swaying and distorting the volitional faculty and occupying it with their anger and desire.

pairs.en: he commands the memory
to record these and not forget them
he restrains fantasy and its demons
confusing and casting doubt on truth
their anger and desire

93.ja: ובעד הד'ה אלתוטיה תנהץ' אלקוה אלאראדיה ג'מיע אלאעצ'א אלמתצרפה להא בנשאט וחרץ ופרח פתקף פי וקת וקוף מן גיר כסל ותסג'ד ענד מא יאמרהא באלסג'וד ותקעד חין אלקעוד ותשכ'ץ אלאעין שכ'וץ אלעבד אלי מולאה ותקף אלידאן ען עבת'המא ולא תג'תמע אלואחדה באלאכ'רי. ותסתוי אלקדמאן ללוקוף ותקף ג'מיע אלאעצ'א כאלבאהתה אלכ'איפה לטאעתהא
93.en: And after this preparation, the volitional faculty rouses all the organs under its governance — with energy, zeal, and gladness. It stands at the time of standing without sluggishness, prostrates when commanded to prostrate, and sits when it is time to sit. The eyes are fixed in the gaze of a servant toward his master; the hands are held still from their idle movements and do not clasp one another; the feet stand level; and all the limbs stand like one dumbstruck with awe in obedience

pairs.en: after this preparation
the volitional faculty rouses all the organs
with energy, zeal, and gladness
the gaze of a servant toward his master
like one dumbstruck with awe

94.ja: לסאיסהא לא יהמהא אן בהא אלמא או כלאלא ויכון אללסאן מטאבקא ללפכר אלא יפצ'ל ענה ולא ינטק פי צלאתה עלי סביל [אל]אעתיאד ואלמלכה כאלזרזור ואלבבגא.
94.en: to its governor — unconcerned whether they suffer pain or weakness. The tongue corresponds exactly to thought, neither exceeding it nor reciting the prayer by mere habit and force, like a starling or a parrot.

pairs.en: to its governor

pairs.ja: לא יהמהא אן בהא אלמא או כלאלא
pairs.en: unconcerned whether they suffer pain or weakness
the tongue corresponds exactly to thought
by mere habit and force
like a starling or a parrot

94.ja: בל מע כל כלמה פכרה ורויה פיהא פיציר וקתה ד'אך לבאב זמאנה ות'מרתה ותציר סאיר אוקאתה כאלטרק אלמוצלה אלי ד'לך.
94.en: Rather, with each word there is deliberation and reflection upon it, so that his time of prayer becomes the very heart of his day and its fruit, while all other times become like roads leading toward it.

pairs.ja: מע כל כלמה פכרה ורויה פיהא
pairs.en: with each word there is deliberation and reflection upon it
his time of prayer becomes the very heart of his day
and its fruit
all other times become like roads leading
toward it

94.ja: יתמני קרבה אד' פיה יתשבה באלרוחאניין ויבעד ען אלבהימיין. פצארת ת'מרה יומה ולילתה תלך אלג' אוקאת אלצלאה ות'מרהֵ אלאסבוע יום אלסבת.
94.en: He yearns for it, for therein he resembles the spiritual beings and distances himself from the animal. So the fruit of his day and night is those three prayer times, and the fruit of the week is the Sabbath day.

pairs.en: he yearns for it
therein he resembles the spiritual beings
and distances himself from the animal
the three prayer times
the fruit of the week is the Sabbath day

94.ja: אד' כאן מוקופא ללאתצאל באלאמר אלאלאהי ועבאדתה בשמחה לא בכ'שוע כמא תבין.
94.en: For it is dedicated to connection with the divine command, and its worship is with joy, not with solemn awe — as will become clear.

pairs.en: dedicated to connection with the divine command
its worship is with joy
not with solemn awe
as will become clear

94.ja: ותרתיב הד'א מן [אל]נפס כתרתיב אלגד'א מן אלבדן פיצלי [ל]נפסה ויגתד'י לבדנה ותבקי עליה ברכהֵ אלצלאה אלי וקת צלאה אכ'רי כבקא קוהֵ אלגדאה חתי יתעשי.
94.en: This arrangement for the soul is like the arrangement of nourishment for the body — he prays for his soul and feeds his body, and the blessing of prayer remains with him until the next prayer time, just as the strength of the meal remains until supper.

pairs.en: this arrangement for the soul
like the arrangement of nourishment for the body
he prays for his soul and feeds his body

pairs.ja: ברכהֵ אלצלאה אלי וקת צלאה אכ'רי
pairs.en: the blessing of prayer remains until the next prayer time
as the strength of the meal remains until supper

94.ja: ולא תזאל אלנפס תתכדר כל מא בעד וקת אלצלאה ענהא במא ירד עליהא מן אשגאל אלדניא לא סימא אן דעת אלצ'רורה אלי צחבהֵ צביאן ונסא ואשראר פיסמע מא יכדר צפא נפסה מן כלמאת פאחשה ואגאני תטרב אליהא אלנפס ולא יקדר עלי מלכהא.
94.en: The soul is constantly becoming turbid as the time of prayer recedes, by reason of the worldly occupations that befall it — especially when necessity calls for the company of children, women, and evil persons, so that he hears words and songs that cloud the clarity of his soul and to which the soul is drawn beyond his power to restrain.

pairs.en: the soul becomes turbid
worldly occupations
company of children, women, and evil persons
obscene words and songs
beyond his power to restrain

94.ja: וענד אלצלאה יטהר נפסה ממא סלף ויהייהא ללמסתאנף ת'ם לא ימר אסבוע עלי הד'א אלתרתיב אלא וקד סימת אלנפס ואלבדן וקד אג'תמעת פצ'ול מכדרה מע טול אלאסבוע לא ימכן תטהירהא ותנט'יפהא אלא באתצאל עבאדה יום מע ראחהֵ אלבדן.
94.en: At the time of prayer he purifies his soul of what has passed and prepares it for the next period. Then no week passes on this schedule without the soul and body having become tarnished, and turbid residues having accumulated over the course of the week, which cannot be purified and cleansed except through a full day of uninterrupted worship joined with bodily rest.

pairs.en: at the time of prayer he purifies his soul
and prepares it for the next period
turbid residues
which cannot be purified except
a full day of worship joined with bodily rest

94.ja: ואלנפס איצ'א תתד'כר מא פאתהא מע שגל אלבדן וכאנהא ד'לך אליום מתעאלג'הֵ מתדאויה מן מרץ' מתקדם ומסתעדה במא ידפע ענהא אלמרץ' פי אלמסתאנף שביהא במא כאן יפעל איוב פי כל אסבוע באולאדה כמא קאל אולי חטאו בני. ת'ם
94.en: The soul too recalls what it missed while the body was occupied, and on that day it is as if being treated and cured of a prior illness, and is being prepared with what will ward off illness in the future — resembling what Job used to do each week for his children, as he said: 'Perhaps my sons have sinned.' Then

pairs.en: the soul recalls what it missed
being treated and cured of a prior illness

pairs.ja: מסתעדה במא ידפע אלמרץ' פי אלמסתאנף
pairs.en: prepared with what will ward off illness in the future
resembling what Job used to do
perhaps my sons have sinned

95.ja: יסתאנף אלעלאג' אלשהרי אלד'י הו זמן כפרה לכל תולדותם יעני תולדות החדשים חואדת' אלאיאם כקולה כי לא תדע מה ילד יום. ת'ם יסתאנף שלש רגלים.
95.en: he renews the monthly treatment, which is the time of atonement for all that they have generated — that is, the offspring of the months, the happenings of the days — as it is said: 'for you do not know what the day may bring forth.' Then he renews the Three Pilgrimage Festivals.

pairs.en: the monthly treatment
the time of atonement for all that they have generated
the offspring of the months, the happenings of the days

pairs.ja: כי לא תדע מה ילד יום
pairs.en: for you do not know what the day may bring forth
the Three Pilgrimage Festivals

95.ja: ת'ם יום אלצום אלמעט'ם אלד'י פיה אלתברי ען כ'טא סלף ויסתדרך פיה כל מא פאתה פי איאם אלאסאביע ואלשהור ותתברא אלנפס מן אלוסאוס אלוהמיה ואלגצ'ביה ואלשהואניה ותתוב ען מסאעדתהא בתה פכרא או פעלא.
95.en: Then comes the great fast-day, on which he is absolved from past sin and recovers all that he missed during the days of the weeks and months. The soul is purged of its vain fantasies, irascible impulses, and appetitive desires, and repents of its having aided them — whether in thought or in deed.

pairs.en: the great fast-day
absolution from past sin
vain fantasies, irascible impulses, and appetitive desires
repents of its having aided them
whether in thought or in deed

95.ja: ואן לם תמכן אלתובה ען אלפכר לגלבהֵ אלכ'ואטר עליהא במא סלף להא מן חפט' מא סמעת מנד' אלצבא מן אשעאר ואכ'באר וגיר ד'לך תבראת מן אלפעל ואעתד'רת מן אלכ'ואטר ואלתזמת אלא תד'כרהא באללסאן פצ'לא ען אן תפעלהא وكמא קיל זמותי בל יעבר פי.
95.en: And if repentance from thought is not possible — on account of the involuntary thoughts that overpower it due to what it has previously stored of poetry and stories heard since childhood — then it absolves itself from the deed, offers excuse for the thoughts, and commits itself never to pronounce them with the tongue, let alone act upon them, as it is said: 'I resolved that my mouth shall not transgress.'

pairs.en: repentance from thought is not possible
involuntary thoughts that overpower it
it absolves itself from the deed
offers excuse for the thoughts
I resolved that my mouth shall not transgress

95.ja: וציאמה ד'לך אליום ציאמא יקארב בה אלתשבה באלמלאיכה לאנה יקטעה באלכ'שוע ואלכ'צ'וע ואלוקוף ואלרכוע ואלתסביח ואלתהליל. וג'מיע קואה אלבדניה צאימה ען אלאמור אלטביעיה משגולה באלשריעה כאנה ליס פיה טבע בהימי.
95.en: His fasting on that day is a fast by which he approaches resemblance to the angels, for he spends it in awe, submission, standing, bowing, praise, and exaltation. All his bodily faculties fast from natural matters and are occupied with the Torah — as if he possesses no animal nature.

pairs.en: a fast by which he approaches resemblance to the angels
in awe, submission, standing, and bowing
praise and exaltation
fast from natural matters
as if he possesses no animal nature

95.ja: וכד'לך יכון צום פאצ'ל מתי צאם אן יצום פיה אלבצר ואלסמע ואללסאן פלא ישגלהא בגיר מא יקרב אלי אללה תעאלי. וכד'לך אלקוי אלבאטנה מן כ'יאל ופכר וגיר ד'לך ויקתרן בד'לך אלאעמאל אלצאלחה.
95.en: Likewise a fast is excellent when the faster also fasts his sight, hearing, and tongue — engaging them in nothing other than what draws near to God Most High — and likewise the inner faculties of imagination and thought and the like; and he joins to this good deeds.

pairs.en: an excellent fast
he also fasts his sight, hearing, and tongue

pairs.ja: פלא ישגלהא בגיר מא יקרב אלי אללה
pairs.en: engaging them in nothing other than what draws near to God
the inner faculties of imagination and thought
and he joins to this good deeds

95.ja: סימן. [ו]. קאל אלכ'זרי אלאעמאל מעלומה. סימן. [ז]. קאל אלחבר אלאעמאל אלסיאסיה ואלנואמיס אלעקליה הי אלמעלומה. ואמא אלאלאהיה אלמזידה עלי תלך לתחצל פי מלהֵ אל חי ידברהא פליסת מעלומה חתי תאתי מן ענדה מפסרה מפצלה.
95.en: Section Six. The Khazar said: The deeds are known. Section Seven. The rabbi said: The civic deeds and rational laws are the ones that are known. But the divine ones — those added above them so as to be realized within the community of the living God who governs it — are not known until they come from Him explained and detailed.

pairs.en: Section Six. The Khazar said
the civic deeds and rational laws
the divine ones added above them
the community of the living God who governs it

pairs.ja: חתי תאתי מן ענדה מפסרה מפצלה
pairs.en: until they come from Him explained and detailed

95.ja: נעם ולא תלך אלסיאסיה אלעקליה ואן ערפת ד'ואתהא פליס יערף תקדירהא. לאנא נערף אן אלמואסאה ואלמשארכה
95.en: Indeed, even as for those civic and rational laws — although their essences are known, their precise measure is not known. For we know that mutual aid and partnership

pairs.en: the civic and rational laws
although their essences are known
their precise measure is not known
mutual aid and partnership

96.ja: ואג'בה וריאצהֵ אלנפס באלצום ואלכ'צ'וע ואג'ב ואלג'בן קביח ואלאנהמאל מע אלנסא קביח ואתיאן בעץ' אלקראבה קביח. ובר אלואלדין ואג'ב ומא אשבה ד'לך. לכן תחדיד ד'לך ותקדירה בחית' יצלח ללכל פאנמא הו ללה תע'.
96.en: are obligatory, that disciplining the soul through fasting and submission is obligatory, that cowardice is base, that indulgence with women is base, that relations with certain close kin are base, that honoring one's parents is obligatory, and the like. But the precise definition and measure of all this, in a way that is fitting for all people — that belongs to God Most High alone.

pairs.en: disciplining the soul through fasting and submission
cowardice is base
honoring one's parents is obligatory
the precise definition and measure of all this
that belongs to God Most High alone

96.ja: ואמא אלאעמאל אלאלאהיה פלא מג'אל פיהא לעקולנא [וליסת] מדפועה ענד אלעקל לכן אלעקל מקלד פיהא כמא יקלד אלעליל [באלטביב] פי אדויתה ותדאבירה.
96.en: As for the divine deeds, there is no scope for our intellects in them; yet they are not rejected by the intellect — rather, the intellect defers to them, just as a sick man defers to the physician in his medicines and treatments.

pairs.en: the divine deeds
there is no scope for our intellects in them
they are not rejected by the intellect
the intellect defers to them
as a sick man defers to the physician

96.ja: אלא תרי אלמילה מע אבעדהא ען אלקיאס ולא מדכ'ל להא פי אלסיאסה. וקד אמתת'להא אברהם עלי צעובה אלאמר ענד אלטביעה והו בן ק' עאם פי נפסה ופי ולדה.
96.en: Do you not see circumcision — how far removed it is from rational deliberation, and how it has no place in civic policy? Yet Abraham performed it, despite how difficult the matter was according to nature, he being a hundred years old in himself and regarding his son.

pairs.en: circumcision
how far removed it is from rational deliberation
it has no place in civic policy
Abraham performed it
he being a hundred years old

96.ja: וצארת אות ברית ליתצל בה ובנסלה אלאמר אלאלאהי כמא קאל והקימותי את בריתי ביני ובינך ובין זרעך אחריך לדורותם לברית עולם להיות לך אלהים וגו'.
96.en: And it became a sign of the covenant, so that through it and through his descendants the divine command might be connected, as He said: 'And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you, etc.'

pairs.en: it became a sign of the covenant
so that through it and his descendants the divine command might be connected
I will establish My covenant between Me and you
throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant
to be a God to you

96.ja: סימן. [ח]. קאל אלכ'זרי בחק אלתזמתם הד'ה אלשריעה עלי מא ינבגי ואמתת'לתמוהא בגאיה אלאהתבאל פי אלחפל ואלתהיו להא ואלתסביח עליהא וד'כר אצלהא ועלתהא פי אלברכה.
96.en: Section Eight. The Khazar said: Truly you have observed this Torah as is fitting, performing it with the utmost care in the celebration and preparation for it, with the praise rendered over it, and the mention of its origin and rationale in the blessing.

pairs.en: Section Eight. The Khazar said

pairs.ja: אלתזמתם הד'ה אלשריעה עלי מא ינבגי
pairs.en: you have observed this Torah as is fitting
the utmost care in the celebration and preparation
the praise rendered over it
the mention of its origin and rationale in the blessing

96.ja: וגירכם ראם אלתשבה בכם פחצל עלי [אל]אלם וחדה דון אללד'ה אלתי יחצל עליהא מן יתכ'יל אלסבב אלד'י מן אג'לה יחתמל הד'א אלאלם.
96.en: And others who sought to imitate you obtained only the pain without the pleasure experienced by one who imagines the reason for the sake of which he endures this pain.

pairs.en: others who sought to imitate you
obtained only the pain
without the pleasure
one who imagines the reason
he endures this pain

96.ja: סימן. [ט]. קאל אלחבר והכד'א סאיר אלתשביהאת לם תקדר אמה מן אלאמם אן תתשבה בנא פי שי אתרי אלד'ין אתכ'ד'וא יומא ללראחה מקאם אלסבת אקדרוא אן יחכוה אלא כמא תחכי צור אלאצנאם צור אלנאס אלאחיא.
96.en: Section Nine. The rabbi said: And so it is with all their other imitations — no nation has been able to imitate us in anything. As for those who adopted a day of rest in place of the Sabbath — were they able to replicate it? No more than images of idols can replicate images of living human beings.

pairs.en: all their other imitations

pairs.ja: לם תקדר אמה מן אלאמם אן תתשבה בנא
pairs.en: no nation has been able to imitate us
a day of rest in place of the Sabbath
were they able to replicate it

pairs.ja: כמא תחכי צור אלאצנאם צור אלנאס
pairs.en: as images of idols replicate images of human beings

96.ja: סימן. [י]. קאל אלכ'זרי קד תפכרת פי אמרכם וראית אן ללה סרא פי אבקאיכם ואנה קד ציר אלאסבאת ואלאעיאד מן אקוי אלאסבאב פי אבקא רמקכם ורונקכם פאן אלאמם כאנת תקתסמכם ותתכ'ד'כם כ'דמה לפטאנתכם וד'כאיכם ולתצירכם
96.en: Section Ten. The Khazar said: I have reflected on your situation and I see that God has a mystery in your preservation — that He has made the Sabbaths and festivals among the most powerful causes for the preservation of the remnant and luster of your life. For the nations would have apportioned you among themselves and taken you as servants for your shrewdness and intelligence, and would have made you

pairs.en: Section Ten. The Khazar said
God has a mystery in your preservation
the Sabbaths and festivals among the most powerful causes
the preservation of the remnant and luster of your life
apportioned you among themselves and taken you as servants

97.ja: מחארבין איצ'א לולא הד'ה אלפצול אלתי תראעונהא הד'ה אלרעאיה לאנהא מן קבל אלאלאה ולעלל קויה מת'ל זכר למעשה בראשית, זכר ליציאת מצרים, זכר למתן תורה.
97.en: soldiers as well — were it not for these intervals that you observe. You observe them because they come from God and for powerful reasons such as: in remembrance of the act of creation, in remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt, in remembrance of the giving of the Torah.

pairs.en: soldiers were it not for these intervals
you observe them because they come from God
in remembrance of the act of creation
in remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt
in remembrance of the giving of the Torah

97.ja: וכלהא אמור אלאהיה מוכדה עליכם מחאפט'תהא ולולאהא מא לבס אחדכם ת'ובא נט'יפא ולא כאן לכם אג'תמאע לתד'כר שריעתכם לכ'מול הממכם בתואלי אלד'לה עליכם.
97.en: All of these are divine matters, obligatory for you to observe. Were it not for them, none of you would put on a clean garment, nor would you have any assembly for recalling your Torah — so crushed would your spirits be by the unrelenting humiliation upon you.

pairs.en: divine matters obligatory for you to observe

pairs.ja: לולאהא מא לבס אחדכם ת'ובא נט'יפא
pairs.en: were it not for them none of you would put on a clean garment
any assembly for recalling your Torah
so crushed would your spirits be
by the unrelenting humiliation upon you

97.ja: ולולאהא מא תנעמתם יומא ואחדא פי טול אעמארכם. וקד חצל לכם בהא סדס אלעמר פי ראחהֵ ג'סם וראחהֵ נפס לא יקדר אלמלוך עליהא.
97.en: And were it not for them, you would not have enjoyed a single day throughout your entire lives. Through them you have gained one sixth of your life in bodily and spiritual rest that no kings are able to achieve.

pairs.en: were it not for them you would not have enjoyed a single day
one sixth of your life
bodily and spiritual rest
that no kings are able to achieve

97.ja: אד' נפוסהם לא תתודע פי יום ראחתהם לאנהם אן דעתהם אקל צ'רורה פי ד'לך אליום ללתעב ואלחרכה תחרכוא ותעבוא פליסת נפוסהם פי דעה תאמה.
97.en: For the souls of kings are not at ease on their days of rest — if the least necessity calls them on that day to exertion and movement, they stir and labor, so their souls are never in complete tranquility.

pairs.ja: נפוסהם לא תתודע פי יום ראחתהם
pairs.en: the souls of kings are not at ease on their days of rest
if the least necessity calls them to exertion
they stir and labor
so their souls are never in complete tranquility

97.ja: ולולאהא לכאן כסבכם לגירכם אד' [הו] מערץ' ללנהב פאנפאקכם פיהא רבח לכם דניא ואכ'רה אד' אלנפקה פיהא לד'את אללה.
97.en: And were it not for them, your earnings would go to others, since they are exposed to plunder. What you spend on these occasions is profit for you in this world and the next, since the expenditure for them is for the sake of God Himself.

pairs.ja: כסבכם לגירכם אד' הו מערץ' ללנהב
pairs.en: your earnings would go to others since they are exposed to plunder
what you spend on these occasions is profit for you
in this world and the next
the expenditure for them is for the sake of God Himself

97.ja: סימן. [יא]. קאל אלחבר פאלכ'יר מנא יראעי מן אלשראיע אלאלאהיה הד'ה אעני אלמילה ואלאסבאת ואלאעיאד ולואזמהא אלמשרועה מן ענד אללה ואלתחפט' באלעריות ואלכלאים פי אלנבאת ואלת'יאב ואלחיואן ואלשמטה ואליובל.
97.en: Section Eleven. The rabbi said: The pious man among us observes these divine laws — namely, circumcision, the Sabbaths, and the festivals and their prescribed obligations from God — and guards against the forbidden sexual unions and the prohibited mixtures of plant, cloth, and animal, and the sabbatical year and the Jubilee.

pairs.en: Section Eleven. The rabbi said
the pious man among us observes these divine laws
circumcision, the Sabbaths, and the festivals
the prohibited mixtures of plant, cloth, and animal
the sabbatical year and the Jubilee

97.ja: ואלתחפט' מן עבודה זרה ומא יתעלק בהא מן טלב עלם גיב מן גיר אלנבוה או אלאורים ואלתומים או אלחלומות פלא יסמע מן זאג'ר או מנג'ם או קראע או מתפאול או מתטאיר.
97.en: And he guards against idolatry and whatever is related to it — seeking hidden knowledge through other than prophecy, the Urim and Thummim, or dreams; he heeds no diviner, astrologer, drawer of lots, practitioner of omens, or augur.

pairs.en: idolatry and whatever is related to it

pairs.ja: טלב עלם גיב מן גיר אלנבוה
pairs.en: seeking hidden knowledge through other than prophecy
the Urim and Thummim
diviner or astrologer
drawer of lots, practitioner of omens, or augur

97.ja: ואלתחפט' מן אלזיבות ואלנדות ואלתחפט' מן אלחיואן אלנג'ס פי אכלה ומסה ומן אלצרעת ואלתחפט' באלדם ואלשחם לאנהא נציב אש ייי. ומראעאהֵ מא ילזמה עלי כל עבירה בשוגג ומזיד מן קרבן חאשי מא ילזמה מן פדיון בכור ואלבכורים ואלבכורות ועלי כל ואלדה תלד ענדה קרבן ומא יתטהר מן זיבות וצרעת קרבן ומנחה חאשי מא ילזמה מן מעשר ראשון ושני ומעשר עני ואלראיון שלש פעמים בשנה ואלפסח ולואזמה אלד'י הו קרבן ייי לאזם לכל אזרח מישראל ואלסוכה ואללולב ואלשופר ומא יחתאג' מן אלאלאת ואלאואני אלמקדסה אלמטהרה להד'ה אלמנחות ואלקראבין ומא יחתאג' הו מן אלתטהיר ואלתקדיס ומראעאה אלפאה ואלערלה
97.en: And guarding against the zav and niddah impurities; guarding against unclean animals in eating and touching; and against leprosy; and guarding concerning blood and fat, for these are the portion of the fire-offering of the Lord. And observing what is obligatory upon him for every transgression — whether inadvertent or deliberate — by way of sacrifice, besides what is required of him for redemption of the firstborn, first-fruits, and firstling animals; and for every birth in his household a sacrifice; and whoever is purified from zav or leprosy brings a sacrifice and a meal-offering; besides what is required of him in first tithe, second tithe, and the poor tithe; the appearance offering three times a year; and Passover with its requirements, which is a sacrifice of the Lord obligatory for every native of Israel; and Sukkot, the lulav, and the shofar; and whatever is needed of sacred and purified vessels and utensils for these offerings and sacrifices; and whatever he needs of purification and sanctification; and observing peah and orlah

pairs.en: guarding against the zav and niddah impurities
unclean animals in eating and touching
the portion of the fire-offering of the Lord
redemption of the firstborn, first-fruits, and firstling animals
Sukkot, the lulav, and the shofar

98.ja: וקדש הלולים ובאלג'מלה פיראעי מן אלאואמר אלאלאהיה מא ימכנה אן יכון צאדקא פי קולה לא עברתי ממצותיך ולא שכחתי. סוי אלנדרים ואלנדבות ואלשלמים ומא ילזם נפסה מן אלנזירות. הד'ה ואמת'אלהא אלשראיע אלאלאהיה ותמאם אכת'רהא בעבודת כהנים.
98.en: and the sanctified fruit of new plantings (orlah) — and in general he observes of the divine commandments whatever enables him to say truthfully: 'I have not transgressed any of your commandments and I have not forgotten.' — besides vows, freewill offerings, peace-offerings, and Nazirite vows he takes upon himself. These and their like are the divine laws, and the completion of most of them is through the priestly service.

pairs.en: and the sanctified fruit of new plantings

pairs.ja: צאדקא פי קולה לא עברתי ממצותיך ולא שכחתי
pairs.en: to say truthfully: I have not transgressed any of your commandments
vows, freewill offerings, and peace-offerings
Nazirite vows
the completion of most of them through the priestly service

98.ja: ואמא אלשראיע אלסיאסיה [פ]מת'ל לא תרצח, ולא תנאף, ולא תגנוב, ולא תענה ברעך, וכבוד אב ואם, ואהבת לרעך, ואהבתם את הגר, ולא תכחשו ולא תשקרו.
98.en: As for the civic laws, they are such as: you shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness against your neighbor, honor father and mother, love your neighbor, love the stranger, and you shall not lie or deal falsely.

pairs.en: the civic laws
you shall not murder
love your neighbor
love the stranger
you shall not lie or deal falsely

98.ja: ותג'נב אלנשך ואלתרבית ותחרי מאזני צדק אבני צדק איפת צדק והין צדק ותרך אללקט ואלעוללות ואלפאות ומא אשבה הד'א.
98.en: And avoiding usury and interest; and seeking just scales, just weights, a just ephah and a just hin; and leaving gleanings, the forgotten sheaf, and the corner of the field — and the like.

pairs.en: avoiding usury and interest
just scales and just weights
a just ephah and a just hin
gleanings, the forgotten sheaf, and the corner of the field

98.ja: ואמא אלשראיע אלנפסאניה [פ]אנכי ייי אלהיך, ולא יהיה לך, ולא תשא. מע זיאדהֵ מא צח פי הד'ה אלשריעה אנה תע' משאהד מטלע עלי צ'מאיר אלעבאד פצ'לא ען אעמאלהם ואקואלהם. ואנה יג'אזי עלי כ'ירהא ושרהא ואן עיני ייי משוטטות בכל הארץ.
98.en: As for the psychic laws — 'I am the Lord your God,' 'you shall have no other gods,' 'you shall not take the name' — together with the additional truth confirmed by this Torah: that God Most High is a witness who sees into the innermost thoughts of His servants, to say nothing of their deeds and words; and that He rewards good and punishes evil therein; and that 'the eyes of the Lord range over all the earth.'

pairs.en: the psychic laws
I am the Lord your God
a witness who sees into the innermost thoughts of His servants
He rewards good and punishes evil therein
the eyes of the Lord range over all the earth

98.ja: פלא יתצרף אלכ'יר ולא יתכלם ולא יפכר אלא ויעתקד אן בחצ'רתה אעינא תראה ותראקבה ותת'יבה ותעאקבה ותנקד עליה כל מעוג' מן קולה ופעלה.
98.en: So the pious man neither acts nor speaks nor thinks without believing that in his presence there are eyes that see him and watch him, rewarding him and punishing him, and counting against him every crooked thing in his speech and deed.

pairs.ja: לא יתצרף ולא יתכלם ולא יפכר
pairs.en: neither acts nor speaks nor thinks
eyes that see him and watch him
rewarding him and punishing him
counting against him every crooked thing
in his speech and deed

98.ja: פהו ימשי ויג'לס כאלכ'איף ואלכ'ג'ל אלמסתחי מן אעמאלה אוקאתא כמא אנה יפרח ויבתהג' ותעט'ם נפסה ענדה אד'א אתי בחסנה וכאנה ימתן עלי רבה אד'א אחתמל משקה פי טאעתה.
98.en: So he walks and sits like one who is fearful and abashed, ashamed of his actions at times — just as at other times he rejoices and exults and feels ennobled within himself when he does a good deed, as though bestowing a gift upon his Lord when he endures hardship in His service.

pairs.en: he walks and sits like one who is fearful and abashed
ashamed of his actions
he rejoices and exults
when he does a good deed

pairs.ja: ימתן עלי רבה אד'א אחתמל משקה פי טאעתה
pairs.en: bestowing a gift upon his Lord when he endures hardship in His service

98.ja: ובאלג'מלה פהו יעתקד וילתזם מא קיל הסתכל בשלשה דברים ואין אתה בא לידי עברה, דע מה למעלה ממך, עין רואה, ואוזן שומעת, וכל מעשיך בספר נכתבים.
98.en: And in sum, he believes in and adheres to what was said: 'Contemplate three things and you will not come to transgression: know what is above you — a seeing eye, a hearing ear, and all your deeds are written in a book.'

pairs.en: contemplate three things
and you will not come to transgression
a seeing eye and a hearing ear
all your deeds are written in a book

98.ja: וירי מא קאל דוד אצדק חג'ה הנוטע אזן הלא ישמע אם
98.en: And he reflects upon what David said — the most valid of arguments: 'He who planted the ear, does He not hear? He who formed the eye,

pairs.en: what David said
the most valid of arguments
He who planted the ear, does He not hear
He who formed the eye

99.ja: יוצר עין הלא יביט. וכל מא קאל פי ייי חקרתני ותדע. ויתפכר פי אן ג'מיע אעצ'אה מוצ'ועה בחכמה ותדביר ונט'אם ותקדיר ויראהא מטיעה לאראדתה והו לא ידרי מא אלד'י ינבגי אן יתחרך מנהא.
99.en: does He not see?' And all that he said in 'Lord, You have searched me and known me.' And he reflects that all his organs are placed in wisdom, deliberation, order, and exact measure, and he sees them obedient to His will — yet he himself does not know which of them ought to move.

pairs.en: He who formed the eye, does He not see
Lord, You have searched me and known me
all his organs are placed in wisdom and deliberation
he sees them obedient to His will

pairs.ja: והו לא ידרי מא אלד'י ינבגי אן יתחרך מנהא
pairs.en: yet he himself does not know which of them ought to move

99.ja: מת'ל אן יריד אלקיאם פיג'ד ג'מאעהֵ [אל]אעצ'א כאלאעואן אלמטיעין קד אקאמת ג'סדה והו לא ידרי תלך אלאעצ'א. וכד'לך אד'א אראד אלג'לוס ואלמשי וסאיר אלנצב.
99.en: For example, when he wishes to stand, he finds the assembly of organs like obedient aides who have already raised his body — yet he does not know those organs. Likewise when he wishes to sit, to walk, and to assume other positions.

pairs.en: when he wishes to stand
organs like obedient aides
who have already raised his body
yet he does not know those organs
sitting, walking, and other positions

99.ja: ואלי הד'א אשאר בקולה אתה ידעת שבתי וקומי ארחי ורבעי זרית וכל דרכי הסכנת.
99.en: To this he alluded when he said: 'You know my sitting down and my rising up; You discern my path and my lying down; and You are acquainted with all my ways.'

pairs.en: You know my sitting down and my rising up
You discern my path and my lying down
You are acquainted with all my ways

99.ja: ואכת'ר מן ד'לך ואדק ואלטף אעצ'א אלנטק. תרי אלטפל יחכי כל מא יסמעה והו לא ידרי [ב]אי עצ'ו ובאי עצ'לה ובאי עצבה ינבגי אן יחכי ד'לך. וכד'לך אלאת אלצדר פי אלחאן אלגנא יחכיהא ויחכמהא והו לא ידרי באי שי כאן כ'אלקהא יחצ'רהא ויצרפהא לה.
99.en: Even more complex, subtle, and intricate are the organs of speech. You see a child imitating everything he hears, yet he does not know by which organ, which muscle, or which nerve he must produce that sound. Likewise the instruments of the chest for the melodies of song — he imitates them and masters them, yet does not know by what means their Creator prepares them and directs them for him.

pairs.en: the organs of speech
a child imitating everything he hears

pairs.ja: לא ידרי באי עצ'ו ובאי עצ'לה ובאי עצבה
pairs.en: not knowing by which organ, muscle, or nerve
the instruments of the chest for the melodies of song
their Creator prepares them and directs them for him

99.ja: ואלאמר כד'לך או קריבא מן ד'לך לאנה לא יתצור אמר אלכ'לקה מת'ל אמר אלצנאעה לאן אלצאנע יצנע רחי מת'לא ויגיב ענהא ואלרחי [תפעל] מא לה צנעת ואלכ'אלק יכ'לק אלאעצ'א ויעטיהא אלקוי וימדהא מע אללחט'את.
99.en: And the matter is so, or close to it, for the act of creation cannot be imagined as analogous to the act of manufacture. The craftsman makes a millstone, for example, and then departs from it — and the millstone performs only what has been made into it. But the Creator creates the organs and gives them their powers, and sustains them moment by moment.

pairs.ja: לא יתצור אמר אלכ'לקה מת'ל אמר אלצנאעה
pairs.en: creation cannot be imagined as analogous to manufacture
the craftsman makes a millstone and then departs from it
the millstone performs only what has been made into it
the Creator creates the organs and gives them their powers
and sustains them moment by moment

99.ja: ולו תוהם ארתפאע ענאיתה ותדבירה אנא ואחדא לפסד אלעאלם באסרה. פאד'א כאן אלכ'יר יתצור ג'מיע הד'א פי חרכאתה כלהא [פכיף לא תכון חרכאתה כלהא] קד אעטי פיהא נציבא ללכ'אלק אלד'י כ'לקהא אולא וימדהא במעונה דאימה פי תמאמהא.
99.en: Were one to imagine the removal of His care and governance for even a single instant, the entire world would be destroyed. Therefore, since the pious man envisions all of this in his every movement, how could he not — in his every movement — have assigned a portion therein to the Creator who first created them and sustains them with constant assistance in their perfection?

pairs.en: the removal of His care and governance for even a single instant
the entire world would be destroyed

pairs.ja: אלכ'יר יתצור ג'מיע הד'א פי חרכאתה
pairs.en: the pious man envisions all of this in his every movement
assigned a portion therein to the Creator
sustains them with constant assistance

99.ja: פהו אבדא כאן אלשכינה מעה ואלמלאיכה תצחבה באלקוה [ו]אן תקוי פי אלכ'יר וכאן [פי] אלמואצ'ע אלמוהלה ללשכינה צחבתה באלפעל וראהא עיאנא דון דרג'ה אלנבואה כמא כאן אכ'יאר אלחכמים פי בית שני ירון צורה ויסמעון בת קול והי דרגהֵ אלאוליא ופוקהא דרג'הֵ אלאנביא.
99.en: He has the Shekhinah constantly with him, and the angels accompany him in potential, strengthening him in good; and in the places prepared for the Shekhinah, their accompaniment is in actuality — he sees it visibly, below the degree of prophecy — just as the most righteous of sages in the Second Temple period would see a form and hear a heavenly voice; this is the degree of the saints, and above it is the degree of the prophets.

pairs.en: the Shekhinah with him
the angels accompany him in potential
the places prepared for the Shekhinah
would see a form and hear a heavenly voice
the degree of the saints, and above it the degree of the prophets

99.ja: פילתזם אלכ'יר מן תוקיר אלאמר אלאלאהי אלחאצ'ר מעה מא ינבגי אן ילתזם אלעבד למולי כ'לקה
99.en: Therefore let the pious man, from reverence for the divine command present with him, commit himself to what a servant must commit to before the Lord who created him

pairs.en: reverence for the divine command present with him
what a servant must commit to
before the Lord who created him

100.ja: ואנעם עליה והו מראקבה לית'יבה או יעאקבה פלא יסתברד קול אלכ'יר קבל ד'כולה אלכ'לא התכבדו מכובדים תאדבא מע אלשכינה ואעתד'ארה בעד אלכ'רוג' בברכת אשר יצר את האדם בחכמה.
100.en: and who has bestowed blessings upon him, while He watches him to reward or punish him. Therefore the pious man should not consider it trivial to say, before entering the privy: 'Honored ones, be honored' — as courtesy toward the Shekhinah — and then, upon exiting, to offer the blessing 'Who fashioned man in wisdom.'

pairs.en: who has bestowed blessings upon him
while He watches him to reward or punish him
Honored ones, be honored
as courtesy toward the Shekhinah

pairs.ja: ברכת אשר יצר את האדם בחכמה
pairs.en: the blessing 'Who fashioned man in wisdom'

100.ja: פמא אג'ל הד'ה אלברכה פי מענאהא ומא אחכם לפט'הא למן תת'בתהא בעין אלחקיקה אד' קדם אולא בחכמה וכ'תמהא ברופא כל בשר ומפליא לעשות דליל עלי גריב מא כ'לקה פי אלחיואן מן אלקוי אלדאפעה ואלמאסכה ושמל ג'מיע אלחיואן בקולה כל בשר.
100.en: How exalted is this blessing in its meaning, and how precise is its language for one who meditates on it with the eye of truth! For it opens with 'wisdom' and closes with 'healer of all flesh' and 'who works wondrously' — pointing to the wondrous nature of what He created in the living body: the expelling and retaining faculties. And it encompasses all living beings with the words 'all flesh.'

pairs.ja: מא אג'ל הד'ה אלברכה פי מענאהא
pairs.en: how exalted is this blessing in its meaning
one who meditates on it with the eye of truth
it opens with 'wisdom'
healer of all flesh and who works wondrously
the expelling and retaining faculties

100.ja: וירבט ניתה באלאמר אלאלאהי בחיל מנהא פראיץ' מנצוצה ומנהא מנקולה פיחמל אלתפלין עלי מוצ'ע אלפכר ואלד'כר מן אלראס ויבת מנהא שרכה תצל אלי ידה ליראהא מע אלסאעאת. ותפלין של יד עלי ינבוע אלקוי אעני אלקלב.
100.en: He binds his intention to the divine command with bonds — some of which are explicitly mandated and some traditional — thus he places the tefillin upon the site of thought and memory on the head, and fastens from them a strap that reaches to his hand so he may see it throughout the hours; and the hand-tefillin is placed at the source of the faculties, namely the heart.

pairs.en: he binds his intention to the divine command
some explicitly mandated and some traditional

pairs.ja: אלתפלין עלי מוצ'ע אלפכר ואלד'כר מן אלראס
pairs.en: the tefillin upon the site of thought and memory on the head
a strap that reaches to his hand

pairs.ja: תפלין של יד עלי ינבוע אלקוי אעני אלקלב
pairs.en: the hand-tefillin at the source of the faculties, namely the heart

100.ja: ויחמל אלציצית כי לא תשגלה חואסה באלדניא וכמא קאל ולא תתורו אחרי לבבכם ואחרי עיניכם ואלמכתוב פי אלתפלין אלתוחיד ואלועד ואלועיד וזכר ליציאת מצרים לאנהא אלחג'ה לא מדפע פיהא אן ללאמר אלאלאהי אתצאלא באלכ'לק וענאיה בהם ועלמא באעמאלהם.
100.en: And he wears the tzitzit so that his senses should not be occupied with the world, as it is said: 'and you shall not stray after your heart and after your eyes.' What is written in the tefillin is: the declaration of Unity, the promise and the warning, and the remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt — for it is the argument admitting of no refutation that the divine command has connection with creation and care for them and knowledge of their deeds.

pairs.ja: אלציצית כי לא תשגלה חואסה באלדניא
pairs.en: the tzitzit so that his senses should not be occupied with the world

pairs.ja: ולא תתורו אחרי לבבכם ואחרי עיניכם
pairs.en: you shall not stray after your heart and after your eyes
the declaration of Unity, the promise and the warning
the remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt
the divine command has connection with creation

100.ja: ת'ם יטרק פי ג'מיע מחסוסאתה אלי אעטא נציב אללה פיהא. וקד נקל אן אקל אלמקאדיר אלתי יתכ'לץ אלאנסאן בה פי אלתסאביח הו מאה ברכות לא אקל מנהא אלמשהורה.
100.en: Then he proceeds through all his sensory experiences, in each giving God His portion. It has been transmitted that the minimum number by which a person fulfills his obligation in praises is one hundred blessings — no fewer is the well-known minimum.

pairs.en: he proceeds through all his sensory experiences
in each giving God His portion
the minimum number in praises
one hundred blessings
the well-known minimum

100.ja: ת'ם ירום מע טול אלאיאם אסתתמאמהא במשמומאת ומאכולאת ומסמועאת ומראיאת יבארך עליהם. וכל מא זאד כאן נאפלה מקרבה אלי אללה.
100.en: Then over the course of the days he rises to perfect his blessings through fragrances, foods, sounds, and sights — pronouncing a blessing over each. And every additional blessing is a supererogatory act drawing near to God.

pairs.en: over the course of the days he rises
to perfect his blessings through fragrances and foods
and sounds and sights
pronouncing a blessing over each
a supererogatory act drawing near to God

100.ja: וכמא קאל דוד פי יספר צדקתך כל היום תהלתך כי לא ידעתי ספורות יעני אן תסביחך לא אחצרה אלי עדד בל אלזמה טול עמרי ולא אכ'לי ענה דאימא. ואלאהבה ואליראה לא מחאלה
100.en: As David said in: 'I will declare Your righteousness all day long; Your praise — for I do not know its measure' — meaning: Your praise I cannot confine to a number; rather I commit myself to it for all my life and will never cease it. And love and awe will inevitably

pairs.en: I will declare Your righteousness all day long
for I do not know its measure
I cannot confine it to a number
I commit to it for all my life
and love and awe will inevitably

101.ja: חאצלה פי אלנפס מע הד'ה אלקראין ומקדרה בתקדיר שרעי כי לא תפרט אלשמחה פי שבתות וימים טובים אלי חד יכ'רג' אלי אללהו ואלשהואת ואלבטאלה ותעטיל אלצלואת פי אוקאתהא עלי מא יג'ב.
101.en: arise in the soul in conjunction with these accompanying practices, and are precisely measured by legal measure — lest joy be excessive on Sabbaths and festivals to the point of descending into frivolity, lust, idleness, and the neglect of prayers at their required times.

pairs.ja: חאצלה פי אלנפס מע הד'ה אלקראין
pairs.en: arising in the soul in conjunction with these accompanying practices
precisely measured by legal measure

pairs.ja: לא תפרט אלשמחה פי שבתות וימים טובים
pairs.en: lest joy be excessive on Sabbaths and festivals
descending into frivolity, lust, and idleness
the neglect of prayers at their required times

101.ja: וכי לא תפרט אליראה אלי חד יויס מן אלגפראן ואלצפאח פיבקי כייבא טול עמרה ויתג'אוז מא אמר בה מן אלשמחה ברזקה כקולה ושמחת בכל הטוב פיקל שכרה עלי נעם אללה.
101.en: And lest awe become excessive to the point of despairing of pardon and forgiveness, leaving him dejected throughout his life, and transgressing the commanded joy in his sustenance, as it is said: 'and you shall rejoice in all the good' — so that his gratitude for God's blessings diminishes.

pairs.en: lest awe become excessive
despairing of pardon and forgiveness
leaving him dejected throughout his life
and you shall rejoice in all the good
so that his gratitude for God's blessings diminishes

101.ja: לאן אלשכר יתבע אלשמחה פיציר כמא קאל תחת אשר לא עבדת את ייי אלהיך בשמחה וגו' ועבדת את אויביך.
101.en: For gratitude follows from joy — and so it becomes as it is said: 'Because you did not serve the Lord your God with joy, etc., you shall serve your enemies.'

pairs.en: gratitude follows from joy

pairs.ja: תחת אשר לא עבדת את ייי אלהיך בשמחה
pairs.en: because you did not serve the Lord your God with joy
you shall serve your enemies

101.ja: וכי לא תפרט פי אלקנאה פי הוכח תוכיח וגו' [ו]מנאט'רהֵ אלעלם פיכ'רג'ה אלי אלגצ'ב ואלחקד ותשתגל נפסה ען אלצפא פי אוקאת אלצלואת.
101.en: And lest he be excessive in zeal over 'you shall surely rebuke' and so on, and in the disputation of intellectual matters — so that it leads him to anger and resentment and keeps his soul from clarity at the times of prayer.

pairs.en: lest he be excessive in zeal
you shall surely rebuke
the disputation of intellectual matters
leading him to anger and resentment
keeping his soul from clarity

101.ja: וימכן מן נפסה צדוק הדין תמכינא יכון לה ג'נה וחג'אבא דון אלרזאיא ואלכ'טוב אלג'אריה פי אלדניא אד'א תמכן פי נפסה עדל כ'אלק אלחיואן וראזקה ומדברה בחכמה לא תדרך אלאד'האן תפצילהא לכן תדרך ג'מלתהא.
101.en: And let him implant deeply in his soul the acceptance of divine justice — to a degree that serves as a shield and armor against the afflictions and calamities that move through the world — if he truly implants in his soul the justice of the Creator of living beings, their Sustainer and wise Governor, whose wisdom in detail the intellects cannot grasp but whose justice as a whole they can apprehend.

pairs.en: the acceptance of divine justice
a shield and armor
the afflictions and calamities that move through the world
the justice of the Creator of living beings
whose wisdom in detail the intellects cannot grasp

101.ja: במא תרי מן אתקאן אלכ'לקה פי אלחיואן ומא תתצ'מן [מן] אלעג'איב ואלגראיב אלדאלה עלי קצד חכים ואראדהֵ עאלם קאדר חתי ג'על למא דק מנהא ומא ג'ל כל מא אחתאג' אליה מן חואס באטנה וט'אהרה ואעצ'א.
101.en: Through what one sees of the perfection of creation in living beings, and what it encompasses of wonders and marvels pointing to the intention of a Wise One and the will of an Omniscient and Omnipotent Being — Who provided for every creature, large and small alike, all it required of inner and outer senses and organs.

pairs.en: the perfection of creation in living beings
wonders and marvels
the intention of a Wise One and the will of an Omniscient and Omnipotent Being

pairs.ja: כל מא אחתאג' אליה מן חואס
pairs.en: all it required of senses
inner and outer senses and organs

101.ja: וג'על אלאת מטאבקה מואפקה ללארואח פציר ללארנב ואלאיל אלאת אלהרב ואכ'לאק אלג'בן וציר ללסבאע אכ'לאק אלג'ראה ואלאת אלכ'לב ואלאפתראס פאן תפכר פי כ'לקה אלאעצ'א ומנאפעהא ונסבתהא מן אלארואח ראי פי ד'לך מן אלעדל ואלנט'אם אלחכמי מא לא יבקי פי נפסה שכא ולא ריבה פי עדל אלכ'אלק.
101.en: And He fashioned the instruments fitting and suited to the spirits — so the hare and the deer were given the tools of flight and the character of cowardice, and the lions were given the character of boldness and the tools of clawing and rending. When one meditates on the creation of organs, their functions, and their proportionality to spirits, one sees in all of this such justice and wise order that no doubt or suspicion of the Creator's justice remains in his soul.

pairs.en: the instruments fitting and suited to the spirits

pairs.ja: ללארנב ואלאיל אלאת אלהרב ואכ'לאק אלג'בן
pairs.en: the hare and deer given tools of flight and the character of cowardice

pairs.ja: ללסבאע אכ'לאק אלג'ראה ואלאת אלכ'לב ואלאפתראס
pairs.en: the lions given the character of boldness and tools of clawing

pairs.ja: כ'לקה אלאעצ'א ומנאפעהא ונסבתהא מן אלארואח
pairs.en: the creation of organs, their functions, and their proportionality to spirits

pairs.ja: לא יבקי פי נפסה שכא ולא ריבה
pairs.en: no doubt or suspicion remains in his soul

101.ja: פאד'א תערץ' שיטאן אלוהם ליערץ' עליה אלג'ור עלי אלאראנב אד' הי טעמה ללסבאע ואלד'באב ללענכבות. רד עליה אלעקל וזג'רה קאילא כיף אנסב אלג'ור אלי חכים קד תקרר ענדי עדלה ואסתגנאה ען
101.en: And when the demon of fantasy arises to suggest to him injustice — since hares are prey for lions and flies for spiders — the intellect repels it and rebukes it, saying: How can I attribute injustice to a Wise One whose justice and self-sufficiency from

pairs.en: the demon of fantasy
to suggest to him injustice
hares are prey for lions
the intellect repels it and rebukes it
how can I attribute injustice to a Wise One

102.ja: אלג'ור ולו כאן ציד אלסבאע ללאראנב וציד אלענאכב ללד'באב באלאתפאק לקלת בחג'הֵ אלאתפאק לכני ארי ד'לך אלחכים אלעדל אלמדבר הו אלד'י יציר אלאת אלציד ללאסד מן ג'ראה וקדרה ואניאב ומכ'אליב.
102.en: injustice have been established for me. Were the hunting of hares by lions and the catching of flies by spiders a matter of chance alone, I could argue by the claim of chance — but I see that the Wise and just Governor is the very one who fashioned the lion's hunting instruments from his boldness, strength, fangs, and claws.

pairs.en: the hunting of hares by lions being a matter of chance
I could argue by the claim of chance
the Wise and just Governor
the lion's hunting instruments
from his boldness, strength, fangs, and claws

102.ja: וציר אלענכבות מלהמא ללחילה וציר לה אלנסג' מלכה דון תעלם ינסג' אלשבאך וציר לה אלאלאת אלמשאכלה להד'ה אלצנאעה ואעד לה אלד'באב מעאשא וקותא כמא אעד לכת'יר מן חות אלבחר קותא מן חות אכ'ר.
102.en: And He inspired the spider with cunning, gave it the craft of weaving without learning, so that it weaves webs, and furnished it with the tools suited to this craft, and prepared the fly as its sustenance and food — just as He prepared for many sea creatures their sustenance from other sea creatures.

pairs.en: inspired the spider with cunning
the craft of weaving without learning
so that it weaves webs
prepared the fly as its sustenance and food

pairs.ja: כמא אעד לכת'יר מן חות אלבחר קותא מן חות אכ'ר
pairs.en: just as He prepared for many sea creatures their sustenance from other sea creatures

102.ja: פהל אקול פי הד'א אנה אלא לחכמה לא אדרכהא ואסלם למן תסמי הצור תמים פעלו. פמן תמכן מן נפסה הד'א צאר כמא יקאל ען נחום איש גם זו כלמא נאבתה נאיבה קאל גם זו לטובה.
102.en: Should I say of all this that it is anything other than wisdom — wisdom I cannot fully grasp — and submit to the One of whom it is said 'His work is perfect'? Whoever deeply implants this in his soul becomes like what is told of Nachum of Gamzu: every time a calamity befell him, he would say 'this too is for the good.'

pairs.en: anything other than wisdom I cannot fully grasp

pairs.ja: ואסלם למן תסמי הצור תמים פעלו
pairs.en: submit to the One of whom it is said His work is perfect
Nachum of Gamzu
every time a calamity befell him
this too is for the good

102.ja: פיעיש עישא לד'יד'א דאימא ותכ'ף עליה אלאחזאן בל רבמא פרח להא אד'א תפטן לד'נב כאן עליה פתמחץ בד'לך.
102.en: Such a person lives ever a pleasant life, and sorrows feel light to him — indeed he may even rejoice at them when he discerns thereby some sin of his that is being purged through them.

pairs.en: lives ever a pleasant life
sorrows feel light to him
he may even rejoice at them
he discerns some sin of his
being purged through them

102.ja: כמן קצ'י דינה ופרח בכ'פיף ט'הרה מנה ויפרח ללד'כ'ר ואלאג'ר אלמדפוע לה ויפרח למא יכסב אלנאס מן אלהדאיה ללצבר ואלתסלים ללה תע' ויפרח למא לה פי ד'לך מן אלת'נא ואלפכ'ר.
102.en: Like one whose sentence has been carried out, who rejoices at the lightening of his guilt's burden thereby; and he rejoices at the remembrance and reward that will be given him; and he rejoices at what others gain through him by way of guidance toward patience and submission to God Most High; and he rejoices at the praise and distinction that comes to him through all this.

pairs.en: whose sentence has been carried out and who rejoices at the lightening of his guilt
he rejoices at the remembrance and reward that will be given him
what others gain by way of guidance
patience and submission to God
the praise and distinction

102.ja: הד'א פי [אלרזאיא אלכ'אצה בה. והכד'א יפעל פי] אלרזאיא אלעאמה אד'א אכ'טרת וסאוס אלוהם עלי באלה טול אלגלות ותשתת אלמלה ומא וצל אליהא מן אלקלה ואלד'לה תעזי אולא בצדוק הדין כמא קלת ת'ם בתמחיץ אלד'נוב ת'ם באלד'כ'ר ואלאג'ר אלמנתט'ר לעולם הבא ואלאתצאל באלאמר אלאלאהי בעולם הזה.
102.en: This is his conduct in personal afflictions. And likewise he acts regarding communal afflictions — when the whispers of fantasy trouble his mind about the long exile, the dispersal of the nation, and the smallness and degradation that has come upon it. He consoles himself first through acceptance of divine justice, as I said; then through the expiation of sins; then through the remembrance and reward awaited in the world to come and the connection to the divine command in this world.

pairs.en: personal afflictions
communal afflictions
the long exile and the dispersal of the nation
he consoles himself first through acceptance of divine justice
the remembrance and reward awaited in the world to come

102.ja: פאן איאסה שיטאנה מן ד'לך בקולה התחיינה העצמות האלה לעט'ים מא דת'ר את'ר נא וג'בר כ'ברנא כמא קיל הנה אומרים יבשו עצמותינו וגו'. פיתפכר פי כיפיהֵ יציאת מצרים וכל מא יקאל פי כמה מעלות טובות למקום עלינו.
102.en: And if his inner demon despairs him by saying 'can these bones live?' — how great is what has obliterated our traces and shattered our remnants — as it is said: 'behold they say: our bones are dried up' — then he reflects on how the Exodus from Egypt came about, and all that is said in 'how many are the good deeds of the Omnipresent toward us.'

pairs.en: his inner demon despairs him
can these bones live
behold they say: our bones are dried up
how the Exodus from Egypt came about
how many are the good deeds of the Omnipresent toward us

102.ja: פליס יצעב עליה כיף ננג'בר ולו לם יבק מנא
102.en: So it would not be difficult for him to imagine how we shall be restored — even were there not left of us

pairs.en: so it would not be difficult for him
to imagine how we shall be restored
even were there not left of us

103.ja: אלא ואחד וכמא קיל תולעת יעקב. מא עסי אן יבקי מן אלאנסאן אד'א צאר תולעת פי קברה.
103.en: but a single one — as it is said: 'worm of Jacob.' For what may remain of a man when he has become a worm in his grave?

pairs.en: but a single one
worm of Jacob

pairs.ja: מא עסי אן יבקי מן אלאנסאן
pairs.en: what may remain of a man
when he has become a worm in his grave

103.ja: סימן. [יב]. קאל אלכ'זרי מת'ל הד'א יעיש פי אלגלות עישא לד'יד'א ויגני ת'מרהֵ דינה פי אלדניא ואלאכ'רה ומן חמל אלגלות מתסכ'טא פכאד אן יפסד אולאה ואכ'רתה.
103.en: Section Twelve. The Khazar said: One such as this lives in exile a pleasant life and reaps the fruit of his faith in this world and the next. But one who bears exile with resentment has nearly ruined both his present and his future.

pairs.en: Section Twelve. The Khazar said
lives in exile a pleasant life

pairs.ja: יגני ת'מרהֵ דינה פי אלדניא ואלאכ'רה
pairs.en: reaps the fruit of his faith in this world and the next
bears exile with resentment
has nearly ruined both his present and his future

103.ja: סימן. [יג]. קאל אלחבר ומא יוכד לד'תה וימכנהא ויזידה לד'ה עלי לד'ה אלתזאם אלברכות עלי כל מא יציב מן אלדניא ועלי כל מא יציבה מנהא.
103.en: Section Thirteen. The rabbi said: And what intensifies his pleasure, makes it possible, and increases one joy upon another is the commitment to blessings upon every worldly benefit he encounters and upon every benefit that comes to him.

pairs.en: Section Thirteen. The rabbi said
what intensifies his pleasure and makes it possible
the commitment to blessings

pairs.ja: עלי כל מא יציב מן אלדניא
pairs.en: upon every worldly benefit he encounters
and upon every benefit that comes to him

103.ja: סימן. [יד]. קאל אלכ'זרי וכיף ד'לך ואלברכות כלפה זאידה.
103.en: Section Fourteen. The Khazar said: How can that be, when blessings are an additional burden?

pairs.en: Section Fourteen. The Khazar said
how can that be
blessings are an additional burden

103.ja: סימן. [טו]. קאל אלחבר אליס אלאנסאן אלכאמל אחק אן יוצף באלאלתד'אד' במא יאכל וישרב מן אלטפל ואלבהימה כמא אן אלבהימה אחק באללד'ה מן אלנבאת ואן כאן אלנבאת פי אגתד'א דאים.
103.en: Section Fifteen. The rabbi said: Is not the perfect human being more deserving to be described as savoring what he eats and drinks than a child or an animal? Just as the animal is more deserving of pleasure than a plant — even though the plant is in constant nourishment.

pairs.en: Section Fifteen. The rabbi said

pairs.ja: אלאנסאן אלכאמל אחק אן יוצף באלאלתד'אד'
pairs.en: the perfect human being is more deserving to be described as savoring
than a child or an animal
the animal is more deserving of pleasure than a plant

pairs.ja: ואן כאן אלנבאת פי אגתד'א דאים
pairs.en: even though the plant is in constant nourishment

103.ja: סימן. [טז]. קאל אלכ'זרי נעם לפצ'ל אלחס ואלשעור באללד'ה פאנה לו סיק אלי סכראן כל מא ישתהיה והו בחאל אלסכר פיאכל וישרב ויסמע אלאגאני ויג'תמע מע מן יחב ותעאנקה מעשוק[ת]ה ת'ם י[ו]צף לה ג'מיע הד'א אד'א צחא לתאסף לד'לך וחסב ג'מיעה כ'סרא לא רבחא למא לם תג'יה תלך אללד'את פי חאל תחציל ואחסאס תאם.
103.en: Section Sixteen. The Khazar said: Yes, because of the superiority of sense and awareness in pleasure. For if all he desires were brought to a drunkard while he is in the state of drunkenness — eating, drinking, hearing songs, gathering with those he loves, embracing his beloved — then all of this were described to him when he sobers up, he would lament it and count it all as loss, not gain, because those pleasures did not come to him in a state of attainment and complete awareness.

pairs.en: Section Sixteen. The Khazar said
the superiority of sense and awareness in pleasure

pairs.ja: סיק אלי סכראן כל מא ישתהיה
pairs.en: all he desires were brought to a drunkard
when he sobers up he would lament it
count it all as loss not gain

103.ja: סימן. [יז]. קאל אלחבר פאלתהיו ללד'ה ואלשעור בהא ותכ'יל עדמהא קבל ד'לך יצ'אעף אללד'את בהא והד'א מן פואיד אלברכות למן אלתזמהא בניה ותחציל לאנהא תצור נוע אללד'ה פי אלנפס ואלשכר עליהא למן והבהא.
103.en: Section Seventeen. The rabbi said: So preparation for pleasure, awareness of it, and imagining its absence before it arrives — all of these redouble the pleasure in it. This is among the benefits of blessings for one who commits to them with intention and attentiveness, for they give form to the kind of pleasure in the soul and to gratitude for it toward the One who granted it.

pairs.en: Section Seventeen. The rabbi said
preparation for pleasure and awareness of it
imagining its absence before it arrives
all these redouble the pleasure in it
gratitude for it toward the One who granted it

103.ja: וקד כנת מערצ'א ללמות פתשכר עלי חיותך ותראה[א] רבחא ויהון עליך אלמרץ' ואלמות אד' חל לאנך אד'א
103.en: And since you were exposed to death, you are grateful for your life and see it as gain — and sickness and death, when they come, are made lighter for you; for when you

pairs.en: since you were exposed to death
you are grateful for your life
and see it as gain
sickness and death are made lighter for you

104.ja: חאסבת נפסך וראית אנך מרבח מע רבך לאנך אהל ללעדם מן כל נעמה בטבעך לאנך תראב ת'ם אנעם עליך באלחיאה ואללד'ה פתשכר. ומתי צרפהא ענד תחמד ותקול ייי נתן וייי לקח וגו'. פתבקא מלתד'א טול עמרך.
104.en: you reckon with yourself and realize that you are gaining with your Lord, for by your very nature you deserve non-existence from every blessing — since you are dust — yet He bestowed upon you life and pleasure, and you give thanks. And when He takes it away, you accept patiently and say: 'The Lord has given and the Lord has taken, etc.' Thus you remain content all the days of your life.

pairs.en: you are gaining with your Lord

pairs.ja: אהל ללעדם מן כל נעמה בטבעך
pairs.en: by your nature you deserve non-existence from every blessing
He bestowed upon you life and pleasure
the Lord has given and the Lord has taken
you remain content all the days of your life

104.ja: ומן לם ילתזם הד'ה אלטריקה פלא תט'ן לד'תה לד'ה אנסאניה לכן לד'ה בהימיה לא יחצלהא כמא קלנא פי אלסכראן.
104.en: And one who does not commit to this path — do not imagine his pleasure to be a human pleasure; it is rather an animal pleasure, and one he cannot even attain, as we said regarding the drunkard.

pairs.en: one who does not commit to this path
a human pleasure
an animal pleasure
one he cannot even attain
as we said regarding the drunkard

104.ja: והכד'א יחצל אלפאצ'ל פי נפסה מעני כל ברכה ויתצור גרצ'הא ומא יתעלק בהא. פיתצור פי יוצר המאורות נט'אם אלעאלם אלעלוי ועט'ם תלך אלאשכ'אץ ועט'ים פאידתהא ואנהא ענד באריהא כאקל אלחשראת ואן עט'מת פי אעיננא לעט'ים אנתפאענא בהא.
104.en: Likewise the distinguished person realizes in his soul the meaning of every blessing and envisions its purpose and what pertains to it. In the blessing of 'He who forms the luminaries' he envisions the order of the upper world, the greatness of those celestial bodies, and the immensity of their benefit — and that in the eyes of their Creator they are like the lowest of insects, even though they appear great to us by reason of the great benefit we derive from them.

pairs.en: the distinguished person realizes the meaning of every blessing
He who forms the luminaries

pairs.ja: נט'אם אלעאלם אלעלוי ועט'ם תלך אלאשכ'אץ
pairs.en: the order of the upper world and the greatness of those celestial bodies
in the eyes of their Creator like the lowest of insects
by reason of the great benefit we derive from them

104.ja: ואלדליל אנה[א ענד] באריהא כמא קלת אן חכמתה ותדבירה פי כ'לקה אלנמלה ואלנחלה ליסת מקצרה ען חכמתה ותדבירה ללשמס ופלכהא בל את'ר אלענאיה ואלחכמה אלטף ואגרב פי אלנמלה ואלנחלה.
104.en: The proof that they are as I said in the eyes of their Creator: His wisdom and governance in creating the ant and the bee are not less than His wisdom and governance in creating the sun and its sphere — indeed, the trace of divine care and wisdom is more subtle and more wondrous in the ant and the bee.

pairs.ja: חכמתה ותדבירה פי כ'לקה אלנמלה ואלנחלה
pairs.en: His wisdom and governance in creating the ant and the bee

pairs.ja: ליסת מקצרה ען חכמתה ותדבירה ללשמס
pairs.en: not less than His wisdom in creating the sun
the trace of divine care and wisdom is more subtle and more wondrous
in the ant and the bee

104.ja: יתפכר פי הד'א כי לא תעט'ם פי עינה אלאנואר פיכ'דעה אלשיטאן בבעץ' ארא אצחאב אלרוחאניאת פיוהמה אנהא תצ'ר ותנפע בד'ואתהא וליס כד'לך. בל בכיפיאתהא כאלריח ואלנאר.
104.en: He meditates on this lest the luminaries become great in his eyes and the demon mislead him through some of the opinions of those who attribute potency to the spiritual spheres — imagining that they can harm and benefit of themselves, which is not the case; they act rather through their qualities, like wind and fire.

pairs.en: lest the luminaries become great in his eyes
the demon mislead him
those who attribute potency to the spiritual spheres
that they can harm and benefit of themselves
they act rather through their qualities, like wind and fire

104.ja: וכד'לך יתצור פי אהבת עולם אתצאל אלאמר אלאלאהי באלג'מאעה אלמתהייה לקבולה כאתצאל אלנור באלמראה אלצקלה. ואן אלשריעה מן ענדה אבתדא אראדה מנה לאט'האר מלכותה פי אלארץ' כט'הורהא פי אלסמא.
104.en: And likewise in the blessing of 'Ahavat Olam' ('Eternal Love') he envisions the connection of the divine command with the community prepared to receive it — like the connection of light with a polished mirror — and that the Torah comes from Him as a first expression of His will to manifest His kingship on earth as it is manifest in the heavens.

pairs.en: Ahavat Olam: Eternal Love
the connection of the divine command with the community
like the connection of light with a polished mirror

pairs.ja: אראדה מנה לאט'האר מלכותה פי אלארץ'
pairs.en: His will to manifest His kingship on earth
as it is manifest in the heavens

104.ja: ולם תקתץ' אלחכמה אן יכ'לק מלאיכה פי אלארץ' בל אדמיין מן מני ודם ותתגאלב פיהם אלטבאיע ותתג'אד'ב אלאכ'לאק בחכם תצ'אד אלאקבאל ואלאדבאר כמא תבין פי ספר יצירה. פמתי צפא מנהם פראד או ג'מאעה חלהֵ אלנור אלאלאהי ודברה בלטאיף וגראיב כ'ארג'ה ען נט'אם אלעאלם אלטביעי ותסמי ד'לך מנה אהבה ושמחה.
104.en: Wisdom did not require that He create angels on earth, but rather human beings from semen and blood, in whom natures contend and characters pull in opposing directions — by the law of the opposition of approach and withdrawal — as is explained in Sefer Yetzirah. When among them an individual or a community becomes clear, the divine light descends upon them and speaks to them through subtle wonders beyond the order of the natural world; and this from Him is called love and joy.

pairs.ja: לם תקתץ' אלחכמה אן יכ'לק מלאיכה פי אלארץ'
pairs.en: wisdom did not require that He create angels on earth
human beings from semen and blood
by the law of the opposition of approach and withdrawal
the divine light descends upon them
love and joy

104.ja: ולם יג'ד אלאמר אלאלאהי קאבלא טאיעא לאמרה לאזמא ללנט'אם
104.en: And the divine command did not find a receptive and obedient subject, constant in the order

pairs.ja: לם יג'ד אלאמר אלאלאהי קאבלא טאיעא
pairs.en: the divine command did not find a receptive and obedient subject
constant in the order

105.ja: אלד'י אמרה בה בעד אלאנואר ואלאפלאך אלא אפאצ'ל אלנאס כאנוא אפראדא מן לדן אדם אלי יעקב ת'ם צארוא ג'מאעה פחלהם אלאמר אלאלאהי מחבה להיות להם לאלהים.
105.en: of which He commanded it, after the luminaries and the spheres — except for the choicest of men, who were individuals from the time of Adam until Jacob, and then became a community. The divine command descended upon them in love, 'to be a God to them.'

pairs.en: after the luminaries and the spheres
the choicest of men

pairs.ja: כאנוא אפראדא מן לדן אדם אלי יעקב
pairs.en: who were individuals from Adam until Jacob
and then became a community
to be a God to them
